correctness.rationale: The full-field Lagrange coefficients are all -1, so normalization by -1 avoids any nontrivial root extraction. The published GRL hull criterion then yields an exact h-dimensional polynomial space in the strict range; a scalar extension matrix handles the unique possible degree boundary. The published s=2 subset-sum criterion gives the AMDS/NMDS distance, and exhaustive GF(8) and GF(27) checks confirm representative hulls and distances.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The 17 September 2026 motivating preprint imposes 2 ell | e in its full-evaluation hull and AMDS constructions. Targeted literature and database searches found no prior arbitrary-index full-evaluation GRL theorem of this form. Earlier literature covers arbitrary Galois indices for GRS/EGRS MDS codes and Hermitian Roth--Lempel variants, which are explicitly excluded from the novelty claim. The recency of the source creates a material near-simultaneous-discovery risk.

value.rationale: The result removes all divisibility assumptions between ell and e for the full-field GRL family, including cases ell does not divide e, preserves the full prescribed-hull range, gives exact length-q+2 AMDS/NMDS parameters, and yields corresponding EAQECC families.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
